ErrorResponse.description: Error returned by contract API failures

IngestResponse.description: Result of a contract upload and initial parse

roles.description: Corrected roles of the party in this agreement

values.description: Corrected fact values; fields must belong to the clause's existing fact schema

primary.description: Corrected primary concept as a taxonomy key; any known key is accepted (unknown names are rejected) and becomes the effective primary even if previously unclassified. null leaves the current correction unchanged; blank clears the concept correction

environmentMatchesSnapshot.description: Whether the snapshot the review froze still matches the live contract semantics and model configuration

CheckView.description: One planned check and how it ended

subjectHeadingNodeId.description: Clause the check judged, when it has one

failureType.description: Exception type of a FAILED check; no message text

DecisionsView.description: Human decision outcomes, which are the natural evaluation labels

ReviewDiagnosticsView.description: Developer diagnostics for one review run. Read-only; contains no contract text and no model output.

reviewFailure.description: Failure reason recorded on the review, if any

backgroundWorkerEnabled.description: Whether a background job worker is running. A queued analysis with no worker will never start.

stalled.description: Operational problems that explain a review making no progress

ContractListItemResponse.description: Contract with its latest version state

ContractSummaryResponse.description: Contract with its latest version state

ContractStructureResponse.description: Canonical structure of a contract version

NodeView.description: One node of the canonical document tree

SourceSpanView.description: Location of a node in the source DOCX

location.description: BODY, TABLE, TEXT_BOX, HEADER, FOOTER, FOOTNOTE, ENDNOTE or COMMENT

ParseCoverageResponse.description: How much of the uploaded file's text the parsed structure holds, from an independent read of the raw file. checked is false for versions parsed before the check existed or when it could not run.

exact.description: False when the check fell back to whole-paragraph matching

extraWords.description: Structure words with no source counterpart

gaps.description: Source text the structure does not hold, in source order
